Bioprinting.title: An Automated Thickness Evaluation Procedure Using an Integrated Structured Light 3D Camera in a Robotic Bioprinting Framework
Bioprinting.summary: Bioprinting is emerging as a tissue engineering technique to replace common treatment methods for large scale injuries. While thickness of the BioPrinted Constructs (BPCs) have shown to be of importance in the cell maturation and integration, the literature lacks a robust, automated, and quantitative method for measuring these metrics.
